name: Kudat Turtle Conservation Society (KTCS)
summary: Creates safe nesting areas for sea turtles in Kudat and Tun Mustapha Park, working with local communities on protection and awareness.
programmes: Community turtle nest protection and hatchling release
Education centre at Kampung Bavang Jamal
Awareness talks in schools and villages
impact: About 4,500 hatchlings released since 2012 (reported July 2017; no newer figures found)
beneficiaries: Sea turtles of Kudat and Tun Mustapha Park; coastal villages in northern Sabah

organisation.founders: Roland Agansai and Francesca Winfield (per Sabah state government news page, 2017)

live.note: No live or video channel found
